name: Observation/reference data provenance and immutable-package verification
purpose: Verify required Dxx package identity, native metadata, hashes, reproducibility, QA, and frozen selections without judging model agreement.
production_capability: Validation-data preflight shared by all data-dependent tests.
production_entry_points: canonical moon_validation_data packages and preparation scripts
configuration: Dataset list declared by the requesting test; raw files read-only.
independent_reference: Native labels/headers plus recomputed SHA-256 and deterministic script reproduction.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic processing; no model residuals used.
procedure: Validate schema/status, recompute hashes, verify raw immutability, rerun processing in a temporary output, compare products, and freeze selections.
acceptance_criteria: Every required artifact present and consistent; QA READY/PASS; deterministic outputs match; unknown blocking metadata causes SKIP/ERROR.
expected_pass_result: The selected package is reproducible and scientifically eligible for its target test.
data_hashes: Recomputed on every run for each evaluated package and written to <Dxx>/verified_hashes.json; nothing is frozen here because each package records its own hashes (SHA256SUMS.txt, raw_inventory.json, provenance.json). Superseded 2026-11-23 snapshot text: mixed local states: D04 QA PASS; D06 QA ERROR; D07 QA INCOMPLETE; D08 PROVISIONAL_NOT_FROZEN; D09 QA PASS; D10 QA PASS but its README says the available processed product is incomplete; D11 QA PASS; D12 recovered-summary status N/A; D13/D14 PARTIAL or provisional; D15 INCOMPLETE; D01-D03 absent
status_semantics: PASS is data-package QA only and never observational validation.
dataset_selection: Untargeted run: every Dxx named in required_data by the U contracts that list U25 among predecessor_gates (parsed at run time); aggregate status is PASS only if every such dataset passes, otherwise the most serious of ERROR, FAIL, SKIPPED. --dataset Dxx / --for-test UXX evaluate a specific target. User decision 2026-11-23.

timestamp_normalization.value_format: ISO-8601 UTC, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[.f]Z, on both sides
timestamp_normalization.rule: A reproduced file may differ from the package copy only on lines carrying one of these fields that packages.json registers for that file; JSON documents must also be equal after deleting exactly the registered key paths. The package SHA256SUMS.txt may then differ only in the entries of those files. Everything else must be byte-identical.

metadata_completeness_policy: The roadmap C6 minimum provenance fields are reported present/absent per package (literal names, no equivalence mapping) and do not gate the result. Byte-identical reproduction is the evidence that processed products were not edited by hand. User decision 2026-11-23.

status_mapping.SKIPPED: package/registry entry/required artifact absent; QA readiness not READY/PASS; observation selection not frozen; no reviewed reproduction recipe; documented interpreter unavailable
status_mapping.ERROR: corrupt JSON; registered key absent; hash/size mismatch against SHA256SUMS.txt, raw_inventory.json or provenance.json; raw or processed file outside the manifests; symlink in the package; reproduction exit/timeout; canonical package changed during reproduction; U25 verifier controls not PASS
status_mapping.FAIL: provenance declares a prohibited method (manual edit, synthetic data, digitization, OCR) as used; a reproduced file differs outside the timestamp rule
status_mapping.PASS: every gate evaluated and met for every selected dataset

verifier_controls: test_package_verification.py runs before any package and must PASS; its fixture packages exercise U25 itself and are never validation data.
